adoption: Schema version 17 records installation time; a run-level v2 requirement is written transactionally before prospective market-rule evaluation. Historical v1 rows retain their original contract and digest; no acquisition timestamps are backfilled.
scope: Additive prospective persistence and offline reconciliation of the v6 reference-price freshness policy. The Binance response timestamp is compared to fresh acquisition UTC after receipt, and to authoritative final admission UTC. The inclusive freshness bound is 300 seconds; acquisition must not follow admission. LAST_FALLBACK and UNVERIFIABLE_AVERAGE retain their distinct existing rule semantics. No executionRules simulation is introduced; that remains Batch H.
